Washing Instructions

  • Check the care label on your velour bathrobe before washing. Some velour bathrobes may have specific instructions or warnings that you need to follow.
  • Wash your velour bathrobe separately from other clothes, especially those that have buttons, hooks or other sharp objects that may snag or damage the fabric.
  • Use cold water and mild detergent to wash your velour bathrobe. You can either wash your velour bathrobe by hand or in a washing machine, depending on the care label instructions.
  • Dry your velour bathrobe on low heat or hang it to dry. Do not over dry your velour bathrobe, as it may cause shrinkage or loss of softness.
  • Iron your velour bathrobe on low heat if needed. Use a pressing cloth between the iron and the fabric, and iron on the wrong side of the fabric.

If you follow these steps, you can keep your velour bathrobe clean and soft for a long time. I hope this helps you with your description.
